basics.name: Mujahid Ali Quidwai
basics.label: AI Systems Engineer
basics.summary: I build AI systems that turn complex data into working tools, with a focus on agents, model post-training, and evaluation. My experience spans scientific research and software product development.

work.name: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
work.summary: Built agents, adapted language models, and developed data workflows for oncology research.
highlights: Designed and implemented OncoCITE: six agents, 22 MCP tools, source attribution, a critic loop, and expert-adjudicated evaluation. Public preprint and code are available.
For OncoDIF, fine-tuned a Llama-3 model with LoRA on 21,000 question–SQL pairs; correct SQL improved from 55% to 83.24% on the study’s unseen questions (ASH 2025 abstract).
Built a 57-process Nextflow genomics pipeline, reducing the observed per-patient workflow from seven days to three hours (56×).
Contributed to collaborative myeloma research in survival modeling, multi-omics integration, and single-cell analysis.

work.name: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
work.summary: Developed retrieval and machine-learning workflows for scientific research.
highlights: Built a myeloma RAG chatbot with source-linked responses and abstention when retrieval lacked relevant evidence; evaluated against language-model baselines (medRxiv 2024; IMS 2024).
Contributed data analysis and ML work to a wearables/cytokine pilot study after CAR-T therapy (JCI Insight 2026).
Fine-tuned Whisper Small for myeloma terminology recognition with on-device use as the target.
Mentored six Carnegie Mellon graduate students on experiment design, baseline comparisons, and reporting for a CAR-T monitoring capstone.

work.name: AYA
work.summary: Developed an education product that turned academic video content into learning questions.
highlights: Selected for NYU Entrepreneurial Institute Summer Sprint, among 10 of 150 startups.
Connected speech processing, NLP, and product development.

work.name: New York University

Teaching assistant for Data Structures & Algorithms for Bioinformatics over three semesters, supporting 130+ master’s students.

publications.name: PA-312 Multi-Modal Single-Cell Profiling of MRD-Negative Patients Identifies Early Immune Signatures Predicting Prolonged Response or Relapse in Multiple Myeloma
publications.summary: Conference abstract. Collaborative single-cell study of immune signatures associated with response duration or relapse in MRD-negative myeloma patients.

publications.name: Detection of cytokine release syndrome using wearables and cytokine profiling following CAR-T therapy for myeloma
publications.summary: Journal article. Prospective pilot with 30 enrolled and 25 evaluable patients. Wearables detected 18/20 CRS episodes with a median lead of about seven hours. Contribution: data analysis.

publications.name: OncoCITE: Multimodal Multi-Agent Reconstruction of Clinical Oncology Knowledge Bases from Scientific Literature
publications.summary: Preprint; under review at Nature Communications. Six agents and 22 MCP tools extract and check oncology evidence against source publications. In 10 retrospective papers, expert review confirmed 44/45 novel extractions and the system recovered 21/25 reference items.

publications.name: Oncodif: An auditable AI framework for automated genomic curation and natural-language clinical querying in hematologic malignancies
publications.summary: ASH 2025 conference abstract. LoRA adaptation of a Llama-3 model on 21,000 synthetic question–SQL pairs improved correct SQL on unseen questions from 55% to 83.24%.

publications.name: Development of predictive relapse indicators for myeloma T cell engagers (PRIME) model for myeloma patients receiving BCMA- and GPRC5D-targeting T cell engagers
publications.summary: ASH 2025 conference abstract. Collaborative research on predictive relapse indicators for patients receiving BCMA- and GPRC5D-targeting T-cell engagers.

publications.name: Integrating Microenvironment with Tumor Multi-Omic using Unsupervised Machine Learning to Model Heterogeneity Refines Multiple Myeloma Subtypes and Reveals Immune-Based Clusters with Prognostic Impact
publications.summary: IMS 2025 conference abstract. Collaborative unsupervised learning study combining tumor multi-omic and microenvironment data to investigate myeloma heterogeneity.

publications.name: P-145 Innovative AI-Driven Decision Support Tool for Multiple Myeloma Using Retrieval Augmented Generation
publications.summary: IMS 2024 conference abstract. Conference abstract describing retrieval-augmented research support for multiple myeloma.

publications.name: A RAG Chatbot for Precision Medicine of Multiple Myeloma
publications.summary: Preprint. A retrieval-augmented chatbot for myeloma research, evaluated on an oncologist-curated benchmark with source attribution and abstention when relevant evidence is missing.

publications.name: Beyond Black Box AI generated Plagiarism Detection: From Sentence to Document Level
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 18th Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Applications (BEA 2023)
publications.summary: Peer-reviewed workshop paper. Sentence- and document-level AI-text detection using paraphrase-generated references and contrastive cosine similarity; 94% document-level accuracy on HC3.
